name: Sawyer
title: Of the Great Saw
examine: Sawdust in the cuffs, the collar, the beard, and the bread. It stops being a nuisance in about a year.
lines: Groa can hear a wet board. I do not know how and I have stopped asking.
Boards to Amberford, beams to the ford, spars to the sea. We never see any of it.
Mind the deck when the slip is running. It does not stop for anyone.
